sentences.en: Unemployment in this part of the country is virtually nonexistent.
sentences.zh: 这个地区的失业率几乎为零。

sentences.en: This increase in unemployment is a consequence of the recession.
sentences.zh: 这次经济衰退导致了失业人数增加。

sentences.en: The unemployment rate dropped to a five-year low in January.
sentences.zh: 一月份失业率降至五年来最低点。

senses.zh: 失业,失业率,失业状况,失业人数

mnemonic: 词根记忆：un（不）+employ（雇用）+ ment→没人雇佣→失业
